entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: Mountainous region in former Fallaji territory of eastern Terisiare on Dominaria, now part of New Argive.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane on which the Kher Ridges lie.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria containing the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: Known location within the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Known location within the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Kher Keep
entities.description: Kobold lair within the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Built his foundry from a massive fallen tree in the Ridges.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: People who thought the Kher Ridges cursed and avoided them.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: Empire whose spirits the Fallaji believed inhabited the Ridges.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Argivian capital sheltered in the northern Khers.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Explosion after which rapid cooling brought glaciers upon Penregon.

entities.name: Fall of Penregon
entities.description: Fifteen-year destruction of Penregon by glaciers following the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Realm of which the Kher Ridges currently form part.

entities.name: Prossh
entities.description: Dragon revered as a god by the Kobolds who plagues the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Kobolds
entities.description: Creatures who revere the dragon Prossh and have a lair in the Ridges.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast causes rapid cooling, and glaciers drive down upon Penregon, leading to its fall over 15 years.
events.quote: rapid cooling led to glaciers driving down upon the city, leading to the Fall of Penregon over 15 years

relations.note: The Argivian capital was sheltered in the northern Khers.
relations.quote: The Argivian capital of Penregon was sheltered in the northern Khers

relations.note: Revered as a god by the Kobolds.
relations.quote: who is revered as a god by the Kobolds
Currently, the Kher Ridges form part of New Argive
